text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text: Dear Mom and Dad, I'm about to run in the Shuka Sho! I was hoping all my fans'd be here to cheer for me as I show them a great run, but…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text: Nobody came. I had a bunch of question marks over my head after that shocker. But then my trainer got rid of them all.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text: Trainer said we should show everyone the results of all the hard work we've put in. So that's exactly what I'm gonna do. And that's why I'm writing this letter… to motivate myself.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text: When I get home, I'm gonna write another letter about the great results I got. …Well, here I go!
